key_insight: RKHS geometry extends necessary optimality conditions from classical rational model reduction to a broader class of kernel-based models.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports norm-based compression of machine learning models and optimized kernel-basis approximations for PDEs.
method: Generalize necessary interpolatory conditions for norm-optimal reduced models in RKHSs.
Develop an IRKA alternative for differentiable kernels.
Use generalized Malmquist–Takenaka bases and unitary transformations to handle non-differentiable kernels.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments cover support vector machines, deep ReLU networks, high-degree polynomial fitting, and a FEM-like PDE method; the abstract reports no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: Necessary optimality conditions alone do not guarantee global norm-optimality, and the abstract does not establish computational scaling.
paper_title: Norm-optimal model order reduction in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces
